question: Should the card represent every visible account as a subscription, or intentionally summarize only the active account for each provider?
rationale: Current product behavior supports multiple managed accounts, while this PR's copy promises all subscriptions but its data model accepts only one snapshot per provider; implementation cannot safely choose that permanent semantic contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Export every visible account
options.body: Make account-scoped sources, rows, totals, and model rankings include each visible configured subscription while omitting private identity from the rendered card.

options.title: Use active accounts only
options.body: Retain one snapshot per provider but rename the action and provenance text to state clearly that the card summarizes active accounts rather than every subscription.

options.title: Pause the sharing surface
options.body: Defer the feature until the account-aware aggregation contract is shared with the related usage dashboard work.

recommendation.title: Export every visible account
recommendation.body: Make account-scoped sources, rows, totals, and model rankings include each visible configured subscription while omitting private identity from the rendered card.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice defines a new user-facing sharing contract across menu, Settings, provider, and multi-account behavior.
